description: Create a Novig API account for your user and get a key without a password. Returns approval_url: show it to your user, who approves in one click (free, no card). Then call finish_signup every 5 seconds with device_code. Costs nothing.

agent.description: Your name, such as Claude Code (optional)

agent_found_us.description: How you, the agent, found us (optional, up to 300)

data_wanted.description: What Novig data your user wants (optional, 3-1000 characters)

found_us.description: How they found us (optional, up to 300)

ref.description: A partner code, if your user came through a partner link (optional)

use_case.description: What they will do with it (optional, 3-1000)

name: start_signup
